mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy shift that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 8.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, triggering reduced corporate revenue expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 1.0% from prior month, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle defined by FEDFUNDS rising above 1.0% for three consecutive months, increased borrowing costs reduce corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.0% for three consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior month signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% from prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0 for two consecutive months, it indicates a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate profits and investor confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO is below 95.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in core inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals disinflationary monetary tightening that reduces real interest rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals an impending demand slowdown that reduces corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines by at least 0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS declines by at least 0.5% during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.
